content: DeS SL1 Champions runs require all 18 bosses to be defeated with screenshots/videos showing **stats, inventory screen, and boss drops/empty arenas.**
If you used any boss souls for items, show them as well for proof. It is strongly recommended to not use boss souls just for souls, as you are effectively destroying your own proof.

content.text: SL1 Slayer of Demon’s Souls proof example, by ledzepphead.

content: DeS SL1 Legend runs require adding **one** of the extra restrictions below onto the base DeS SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

challenges.title: SL1 No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: Flawless fights are required for this run

content: DeS SL1 Master runs are equivalent to adding **two** of the extra restrictions from the Legend list onto the base DeS SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

challenges.title: SL1 +0 Weapons No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: Special Weapons (Demonbrandt, Soulbrandt, Northern Regalia, Phosphorescent Pole) are banned

challenges.title: SL1 NG+5 PBWT +0 Weapons
items: Special Weapons (Demonbrandt, Soulbrandt, Northern Regalia, Phosphorescent Pole) are banned

content: DeS SL1 Elite Master runs is a step up in the challenge provided by Master, the required bosses remains the same. For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained.

challenges.title: SL1 NG+5 PBWT +0 No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: Clever Rat Ring is allowed in this run

challenges.title: SL1 NG+5 PBWT No Sprinting/Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: No Hyper (Clever Rat Ring & Morion Blade)

content: DeS SL1 Grand Master runs is the highest recognised challenge in Onebros, it is by no means the hardest challenge however after discussion we've decided to pull the brakes here and leave it to the runners to push it even further. The required bosses remains the same. For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained.

challenges.title: SL1 NG+5 PBWT Human Form +0 No Rolling/Blocking/Parrying
items: No Hyper (Clever Rat Ring & Morion Blade)

restrictions.title: Legend And Above Banned Equipment and Strategies

groups.title: Allowed
items: Healing the leech damage in Leechmonger's arena is allowed.

items.text: **Stealth vs. Maneaters** is allowed to fight them individually.
items: Stealth means hiding behind pillars, not using concealment- sources of concealment are still banned.
**Mid-stagger vs. False King Allant** is allowed to temporarily stunlock him.

groups.title: Banned
items: **Clever Rat's Ring and Morion Blade** are banned. They’re too strong.
**All Magic Spells/Miracles** are banned. They’re either too strong or promote error prone play.
Concealment **(Thief's Ring, Graverobber’s Ring, etc.)** is banned. It trivializes many fights and promotes passive play.

content: For SL1 No Hit runs, we use Team Hitless’ ruleset- please check their website to see their rules.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes SL1 Any% or SL1 All Bosses No Hit.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes a restricted Any% or All Bosses such as SL1 Any% No Roll or SL1 Any% +0.
